summary: Frontend-only auth-bridge verification completed on mobile viewport against preview URL. Sign-in button correctly routed to /auth-webview, auth-webview screen loaded without crash, fallback web card and open button rendered, and no red-screen/routing error indicators were detected.

ui_bugs.component: Auth web bridge helper URL text
ui_bugs.issue: Long sign-in URL in helper text visually overflows/clips in mobile viewport, reducing readability.

integration_issues.flow: Complete sign-in via external Hercules/web callback
integration_issues.issue: End-to-end authentication completion could not be fully validated in automation because callback redirect with live credentials/tokens from web side is not available in this run.

issues: Helper URL text needs wrapping/ellipsis strategy for narrow mobile widths.

action_items: Validate real callback handoff from smilers.online/Hercules to mobile callback URL in a manual authenticated run.
Adjust helper URL text style to avoid clipping on small mobile widths.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthProvider AUTH_MODE currently resolves to 'webview' whenever WEB_APP_URL is set (including default fallback), which effectively bypasses EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_MODE toggling and may limit environment-based auth mode control.
Required testIDs for this feature are present and stable (sign-in-btn, auth-webview-screen, auth-webview-web-card, auth-webview-open-web-button), enabling reliable automation coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth docs and credentials file were reviewed before testing. Feature-specific route stability passed in automation; remaining validation is live callback completion from web/Hercules side.
rca_of_issue: No crash/RN red-screen issue reproduced in requested bridge flow. Minor UI issue root cause: helper URL text inside fallback card has no explicit wrapping/truncation handling for long callback query strings on 375px width.
